title: Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs Video Lectures (1986)
ai_summary:
• Released in 1986, the "Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs Video Lectures" features MIT's Harold Abelson and Gerald Jay Sussman.
• Based on the book by Abelson, Sussman, and Julian S. Ullman, the lectures present concepts in computer science and programming.
• The lectures cover fundamental concepts in computer science, including data abstraction, recursion, and iteration.
